name: Jaffna Grand Mosque (Osmania Mosque)
description: Jaffna Grand Mosque (Osmania Mosque), a stunning Islamic landmark in Jaffna, stands proud amidst lush greenery. Built in 1928, it's a testament to the rich cultural heritage of the Northern Province, featuring intricate Arabic calligraphy and a serene courtyard.
activities: Prayer and Reflection, Photography, Cultural Tours

name: Jaffna Town Mosque (Second Mosque)
description: Jaffna Town Mosque (Second Mosque), a historic Islamic landmark in Jaffna, stands proudly amidst the ruins of war, its intricate architecture reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the region. Built in the early 19th century, this mosque is a testament to the resilience and unity of the local Muslim community.
activities: Explore the historical significance of the mosque, Learn about the local Muslim culture, Take photos of the serene surroundings
